title: BATWA v2.4.23 Official Release
message: Account Details & IBAN Modal with one-tap copy, authentic Batwa-to-Batwa realtime transfers, zero fee configuration, ultra-fast local routing, and verified account pack.
features: Direct Account & Banking Info Modal: Right-side golden pod on Balance Card taps directly to view Account Number (Raast ID), 24-character IBAN, Account Title/Username, Bank Name (BATWA / Raast), each with individual one-tap copy buttons.
One-Tap Complete Shareable Pack: Dedicated styled container with formatted full account details ready for WhatsApp/SMS with "Copy All Account Details" button.
Real-Time Batwa-to-Batwa & 0% Fee Execution: Zero fee configuration and high-speed local USB/LAN routing for sub-second authentic transfers.

Pre-Transaction MPIN Verification: MPIN ab transfer animation/procedure shuru hone se pehle hi bottom sheet ke andar verify hota hai. Galat hone par sheet ke andar red warning aur haptic vibration aati hai, transfer process tabhi shuru hota hai jab MPIN theek ho.
Seamless Transaction Execution: Valid MPIN verify hone par direct backend fund transfer execute hota hai aur balance realtime update hota hai.
Enlarged Statistics Pentagon Analysis: Statistics Spending box ke andar pentagon radar chart ka scale 40%+ barha diya gaya hai without altering box dimensions
Streamlined Profile & Settings: AI Assistant box drawer menu se remove kar ke clean, high-security layout banaya gaya hai
Direct Clean Notifications Hub: Green banner alert box ko notifications screen se remove kar ke direct transaction feed view banaya gaya hai
Instant In-App Heads-Up Notifications: Money sent ya payment received par top-sliding luxury notification banner with haptic feedback
Real-Time Payment Received Alerts: Dusre user se paise aane par foran notification aur dashboard balance auto-refresh (no pull-to-refresh needed)
Dynamic 3D Golden Bell Badge: Unread alerts counter realtime update hota hai aur read karne par automatically clear ho jata hai
Real Backend Notifications Feed: NotificationsScreen live PostgreSQL database se authentic transactions aur date groups fetch karta hai
New Luxury Neo-Banking Receipt Design: Revolut/Apple Pay style 28px floating voucher card with triple glowing emerald checkmark
Visual Sender-to-Beneficiary Flow: Real-time pathway displaying sender account, 0s Raast instant switch, and verified recipient details
Digital Security Barcode: Authenticity verification with SBP Licensed EMI watermark and Raast/1Link chips
Full Operational Settings: Har setting option backend aur storage ke sath fully integrated aur responsive hai
Automatic In-App Update Prompt: Instant 3D Update dialog on app launch when a new version is released
changelog: Enlarged pentagon radar canvas in Analytics Spending card inside fixed 146px container
Removed AI Assistant quick card from drawer_underlay_screen.dart profile settings
Removed dark green '1 New Pending Alert' hero card from notifications_screen.dart
